pairs.subject: eval-harness
pairs.evidence: src/components/dashboard/views/director/useDirectorData.ts:8 The view renders mock fixtures of 0–5 Director verdict scores (directorMeta.ts only derives display tones, momentum and attention flags from them), and the scoring itself happens in the desktop app; this repo runs no scenarios, trials or judge calls, so the eval-harness machinery (pinned judges, aggregation, scenario versioning) has nothing to govern here. A search of director/ for judge, rubric, benchmark, passRate and golden found zero hits; 'verdict' and 'score' do appear, but only as display fields of the mocked data.
pairs.registryProposal: The use_when match on 'score'/'verdict' pulls display-only dashboards of judge output into eval-harness. The subject could say plainly that rendering a judge's verdicts is out of scope when the judging runs in another system.
